'''Sanl'jek''' was the [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologist]] who discovered the existence of the [[sanl'jek]] species on [[Dancreti]]. The species was named after him.<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
